title: L'heure décisive

Denise, paid discreetly and eager to escape the air of condescension, returns home to a cramped flat, where her bitter mother, easygoing father, and schoolboy brother reveal a family strained by past ruin and present economies; alone on her balcony, she longs for love yet vows to keep her integrity.
